input.title: 2023 Old Town Sportsman Autopilot 136
input.descriptionHtml:
Financing Available - Starting at $239.55 / Month, $0 Down, and all taxes and fees included!*

Elevate Your Fishing Experience with the Old Town Sportsman AutoPilot 136

Financing Available!

Book a FREE On-Water Demo!

 
Discover the ultimate fishing adventure with the Old Town Sportsman AutoPilot 136, a motorized kayak designed for anglers seeking cutting-edge performance and unmatched comfort. Enjoy effortless navigation with the 45 lb. thrust 12V Minn Kota motor and maintain your position using the groundbreaking Spot-Lock technology. Financing options are available starting at $239.55 per month with $0 down and all taxes and fees included*.

Control your kayak with ease using the Bluetooth-connected i-Pilot remote and benefit from hands-free fishing with foot brace steering for exceptional maneuverability. Stay comfortable all day with the premium UV-resistant dual-layer Textilene seat and breathable 3D mesh. The seat is removable for transport and can be positioned high or low.

The spacious open cockpit and aft tank well offer ample space for all your fishing gear, while the four 18-inch tracks allow for easy mounting of accessories. The AutoPilot 136 is equipped with flush mount rod holders, non-slip EVA foam deck pads, shallow water anchor mounting inserts, and an extra-large rudder for superior control. Additional features include a motor lift assist, kill switch key, console floor plug, and custom tackle box.

Built for durability, this single-paddler sit-on-top kayak has a total weight capacity of 660 lbs and a usable weight capacity of 427 lbs. The AutoPilot 136 measures 13 ft 6 in in length and 37 in in width, with the removable seat and motor console weighing 6 lbs and 24 lbs respectively.
 

** 12V Batteries Sold Separately **

** Please note: Motorized Kayaks are required to be titled and registered in Illinois. Title and Registration is handled by Quest Watersports at a $94 fee **

*Must be approved by Synchrony Financial with a large enough credit line to cover the purchase price. Listed price assumes 24-month financing and equal payments across those months, your minimum payment may be different. Call (815) 433-2200 for more info or click here to apply

 
Number of Paddlers: 1
Propulsion: Motorized
Total Weight Capacity:  660 lb | 299.38 kg
Usable Weight Capacity:  427 lb | 193.69 kg
Assembled Boat Weight:  158 lb | 71.6688 kg
Removable Seat Weight: 6 lb | 2.72 kg
Motor Console Weight: 24 lb | 10.89 kg
Length: 13 ft 6 in | 4.1 m
Width: 37 in | 94 cm
Material: Single Layer Polyethylene

The saltwater-ready 45 lb. thrust 12V Minn Kota motor gets you effortlessly there and back Spot-Lock technology holds your kayak in position despite wind and current. Maintain your position while keeping your hand free to cast, fight a fish or change lures. Motor combines with foot brace steering for truly hands-free fishing and exceptional maneuverability Premium seating for all day comfort. Dual-layer Textilene is durable, UV resistant and easy to clean. A mid-layer of 3D mesh adds comfort without inhibiting Textilene's natural breathability. Position seat high or low in the kayak. Removable for transport Large open cockpit and aft tank well provides a platform that is easy to organize with plenty of room to fish! Four 18" tracks enable easy on/off mounting of accessories Two forward-facing and two rear-facing flush mount rod holders are there when you want them, and out-of-the-way when you don't Non-slip EVA foam deck pads provide traction and stand-up comfort Equipped with shallow water anchor mounting inserts Extra large rudder provides excellent boat control in forward and reverse Lift assist helps deploy and stow motor quickly in shallow water or when launching and landing. 24 lbs. motor console can be removed for transport Kill switch key holds the spare prop pin and doubles as a prop wrench Console floor plug stores in the tank well and can be used to keep water out when the motor is removed or you want to paddle Custom tackle box included Lead-acid or lithium-ion battery compatible Three through-hull wiring kits and a universal transducer mount allow you to mount a fish finder in minutes without the need to drill into your kayak.
